title: Script30 Error Contracts guiding principle
description: Org-level guiding principle for error contracts: HTTP status classification, validation gates, retry budgets, fallback chains, dead letter queues, and timeout escalation.
code:
# Error Contracts — Org Guiding Principle

## HTTP Status Classification
- 400-499 are client errors, 500-599 are server errors. Never lump them together.
- Emit orgops.metrics.emit("error.mapped", status_code) on every classification.

## Validation Gates
- Collect ALL validation errors before returning, never short-circuit on first error.
- Record orgops.compliance.record_decision("validation.completed", error_count=n).

## Retry Budgets
- Replenish budget on success (min(remaining + 1, max_budget)), not just decrement on failure.
- Emit orgops.metrics.emit("retry.budget.consumed", remaining) after each outcome.

## Fallback Chains
- Always propagate context to fallback functions: fb(context), not fb().
- Annotate orgops.tracing.annotate_span("fallback.activated", index) on each fallback.

## Dead Letter Queues
- Capacity check: len(queue) >= max_size (not >), preventing off-by-one overflow.
- Alert orgops.alerts.notify("dlq.capacity.warning", utilization_pct=pct) at 80%+.

## Timeout Escalation
- Compound escalation: original_ms * (multiplier ** attempt), not just original_ms * multiplier.
- Emit orgops.metrics.emit("timeout.escalated", new_timeout_ms) after escalation.
